page.notes: Left-page edge fragments at the far left are the neighbouring page and were not transcribed. The reference marks "f" and "t" stand as superscript letters in the text; the notes beside them are the marginal notes "Orat.in laudem Basilij." and "Epist.70.". "Nazianzenus" after "(inquit" is set in italic and its first letter is a stylised form, read as N [?]. The word "Nazianzeni" is also italic and reads as printed. The word "cocetaneus" is as printed. The last line "Christi-" breaks at the page foot; "anorum" is the catchword on the same line to the right.
